prompt:
Create an original production pixel-art VFX animation sheet for a detailed chibi wuxia top-down 3/4 RPG, transparent background. These are VFX only, no characters, no UI, no lettering. Exactly 4 columns and 5 rows, 20 separate fully visible cels, with generous transparent gutters. Uniform grid. Each row is one coherent effect progressing left to right through four distinct animation drawings; do not draw a contact sheet with labels. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, ivory/jade/pink peach-blossom palette, no blurred haze, no background.
Row 1: very long narrow sword THRUST streak toward RIGHT, luminous ivory pointed blade qi with delicate jade edge and a few pink petals. Anticipation small spear -> fully extended pointed thrust -> double thin thrust -> fading point. NOT a curved slash.
Row 2: a single small ROUND polished jade/ivory PEBBLE bullet toward RIGHT with short thin streak behind it. 4 distinct glint/trail frames. Round bead head clearly visible, never sword or hand.
Row 3: ground patch of scattered individual peach PETALS, foreshortened top-down ellipse, no ring/no magic seal. Four frames settling and quietly pulsing pink as a delayed explosion warning; keep the same footprint.
Row 4: peach petal ground EXPLOSION. compressed pink petals -> sharp ivory/pink blossom-shaped blast -> larger irregular spray of petals -> dissipating fragments. Distinct quiet ground warning vs violent burst. No fire, no force-wave circle.
Row 5: HEALING PALM projectile traveling RIGHT: small translucent jade hand/palm silhouette with ivory center, two peach petals and narrow mint trail, four changing frames. No weapon, no damage flames, no circle or shield.
Style match finely textured hand-finished RPG VFX, precise edges readable at 1x small gameplay scale. Cels must be cleanly separated, no ornaments or text.

Original production pixel-art VFX sprite sheet, transparent background. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and SEVEN ROWS, 28 separate cels with large clear transparent gutters. Row-major animations, four distinct frames per row. No labels, no numbers, no characters, no frame borders, no floor or backdrop.
Detailed chibi wuxia elevated top-down 3/4 RPG effect style. All magic is deep BURGUNDY/OXBLOOD, dark crimson, wine red, with sparse pale bone-pink hot edges, never purple/lime/green. Crisp pixel clusters, no blurry glow or ambient haze, preserve empty transparent space.
Row1: LEFT-HAND BONE CLAW sweep moving RIGHT, 3 ivory claw tips and deep wine-red wispy slash, four sequential drawings anticipation/contact/extension/fade.
Row2: complementary RIGHT-HAND BONE CLAW sweep moving RIGHT, opposite curve so the two slashes read as left/right alternating rips in front of a boss, four sequential drawings.
Row3: LONG-RANGE spectral claw projectile moving RIGHT, five long thin burgundy talons with bone-pink tips and dark red streaming afterimage, four traveling frames. Sharp claws, not a laser.
Row4: INWARD SUCTION ground vortex, flattened top-down ellipse with curved dark-red wind tendrils drawn pointing toward the center, four changing frames. Do not include arrows or glyph text.
Row5: THROWN POISON POUCH, small tied red-brown cloth medicine sack with bone clasp, trailing wine-red poison droplets, four distinct airborne tumble drawings oriented right. This is a fabric pouch, NOT a skull.
Row6: LARGE POISON POUCH GROUND DETONATION, bursting bag -> violent crimson poison splash -> expanding dark burgundy poisonous smoke with pink flecks -> settling droplets, four progression drawings.
Row7: LINGERING POISON GROUND POOL, irregular flattened burgundy liquid patch with deep-red bubbles and small dark red wisps, four slowly evolving drawings sharing a stable footprint. No glowing green poison.
Keep all artwork within own regular grid cell and no touching adjacent cels. Real authored crisp pixel art, no geometric placeholders.

Use the two reference images only to preserve the EXACT existing Dong Ta character identity and pixel-art language. Create a NEW original animation sheet for his FLUTE casting pose, not a concept page. Transparent background, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 full-body cels, generous clear gutters, no text or VFX.
Same elder male: long silver-white hair, white mustache and pointed beard, dark jade green layered robe with pale ivory inner tunic, gold fine embroidery, jade/gold hair crown, long teal ribbons, black boots. Detailed chibi wuxia pixel art with crisp pixels. Elevated orthographic three-quarter RPG perspective; not side-scrolling or isometric.
Row1: facing DOWN/front. Four chronological frames: draw green transverse jade flute from belt; lift flute horizontally across mouth with TWO hands; visibly BLOW flute with both hands placed on finger holes; settle while still playing, sleeve/hair slightly flowing.
Row2: facing LEFT. Same 4 phases, clear flute at lips, flute extends to his left. Body/face truly faces left.
Row3: facing RIGHT. Same 4 phases, flute at lips extends to his right.
Row4: facing UP/back. Same 4 phases viewed from rear; silver hair and robe back preserved, forearms/flute partially visible at side of head.
Sword remains sheathed at belt, never held while blowing flute. No mystical orb, sword-wave, hand-only cast, extra weapon or third hand. Flute must be clearly recognizable thin green tube with gold ends; both hands touch it. Every cel equal character scale and planted foot baseline. Each row stays same orientation throughout. No fake animation by rotating an idle, draw real arm/hand changes. Keep all sprite silhouettes completely inside each own grid cell.

Targeted correction: draw ONLY FOUR full-body animation cels in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of Dong Ta playing his jade flute while facing LEFT. Transparent, large margins. Use references for exact identity: silver long hair, mustache and pointed beard, gold jade crown, dark jade embroidered robes/ivory tunic/black boots, teal ribbons. Detailed chibi pixel-art, elevated orthographic 3/4 overworld view.
CRITICAL all faces/noses point toward LEFT EDGE of the picture. Silver hair streams to the RIGHT behind the head. Jade transverse flute extends toward the LEFT of his mouth. BOTH hands hold the flute at lips. Not facing right; no front-facing torso.
Frame1 LEFT profile taking flute out of belt; frame2 LEFT profile lifting flute; frame3 LEFT profile blowing flute with both hands on finger holes; frame4 LEFT profile continuing to blow with fingers/sleeves subtly changed. Sword sheathed at hip. Entire character and flute contained within its own quarter of the image, no overlap. Exactly four cels, same body scale, same fixed foot baseline. No VFX, no text, no shadow plate, no extra poses or rows. Preserve character design.

Create a new THRUST sword attack animation sprite sheet for the EXACT existing Dong Ta elder from the references, preserving his identity, clothing and palette. Transparent background, 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 distinct full-body cels, large transparent gutters and margin at all image edges. No text, labels, VFX or scenery.
Character: same silver long hair, moustache/pointed beard, gold/jade crown, jade dark-green embroidered robe, ivory tunic, teal ribbons, black boots. Detailed chibi wuxia crisp pixel-art, orthographic elevated 3/4 RPG view.
Every row is a four-pose sword STAB combo: anticipation draw sword back; arm EXTENDED STRAIGHT forward for a very long pointed thrust; retract then second forceful straight thrust slightly different forward angle; recover. NO overhead chops or broad sweeping slashes. Single straight steel jian sword, exactly one sword and two arms.
Row1 DOWN/front: face and thrust toward bottom of image.
Row2 LEFT: face points toward LEFT edge of image, nose points LEFT, sword tip extends LEFT, hair streams RIGHT. All four sprites must truly face LEFT.
Row3 RIGHT: face points RIGHT, sword tip extends RIGHT, hair trails LEFT.
Row4 UP/back: back of silver head and green embroidered robe visible; thrust toward upper edge; do NOT turn face toward camera.
Feet planted on consistent baseline, torso and head same dimensions through all frames. Leave enough horizontal clearance for long sword, keep blade and tip completely inside each cel. Preserve authored character; do not redesign.
